Given the high mask confidence (0.98), the boundary is solid, suggesting the spot is internal to the object. I will maintain a low severity rating as it doesn't disrupt the overall structure.

This is consistent with the 'perceptual_quality_auditor' finding of slight lack of sharpness. It is not a catastrophic structural failure but a minor fidelity issue.
